name: MAST 3531
title: Maritime Archaeology of the Americas
description: (Also offered as ANTH 3531, HIST 3209.) Archaeological and historical sources to examine the development of seafaring practices, exploration, waterborne trade and economic systems, naval warfare and shipbuilding in the Americas from the fifteenth to the beginning of the twentieth century.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: ANTH 1500, ANTH 2501, ANTH 2510 or HIST 3544.
